components.css: .ds-review{max-width:430px;min-height:260px;padding:30px;border-radius:14px;color:var(--asphalt,#162321);background:var(--white,#fffef8);font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(3,12,10,.16)}.ds-review header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px}.ds-review header div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.ds-review small{opacity:.68}.ds-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;color:#fffef8;background:var(--asphalt,#162321);font-weight:700}.ds-stars{color:#d94e2d}.ds-review p{margin:30px 0 0;font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.62}.ds-review:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff5c35);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-service{min-height:190px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px 1fr 30px;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding:30px 8px;color:var(--asphalt,#162321);background:var(--mineral,#f2f0e7);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#a9b0a8);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#a9b0a8);font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;text-decoration:none}.ds-service-mark{color:var(--orange,#ff5c35);font-size:2.5rem}.ds-service h3{margin:0 0 10px;font:600 2rem/1 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-service p{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#53615d);line-height:1.55}.ds-service-arrow{transition:transform .2s ease}.ds-service:hover .ds-service-arrow{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}.ds-service:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff5c35);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Hero Visual
components.description: One disclosed crew concept image with a compact verified Google proof badge.
components.css: .ds-hero-visual{position:relative;width:min(100%,620px);min-height:360px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;background:var(--sage,#b8c1aa);box-shadow:0 28px 54px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}.ds-image-field{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#64746c,#162321);animation:ds-roof-settle 1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-concept-label{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--asphalt,#162321);background:rgba(255,254,248,.92);font:700 .72rem/1.2 'Source Sans 3',sans-serif}.ds-hero-proof{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--asphalt,#162321);background:var(--orange,#ff5c35);font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;text-decoration:none}.ds-hero-proof strong{font:600 2.7rem/.8 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-hero-proof span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-hero-proof:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}.ds-hero-proof:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff5c35);outline-offset:4px}@keyframes ds-roof-settle{from{transform:scale(1.035);filter:saturate(.68) contrast(1.12) blur(3px)}to{transform:scale(1);filter:saturate(.8) contrast(1.08) blur(0)}}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-concept-label{top:12px;bottom:auto}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-image-field{animation-duration:.01ms;animation-iteration-count:1}}

components.css: .ds-estimate{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;padding:30px;color:#fffef8;background:var(--asphalt,#162321);font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif}.ds-estimate label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-weight:700}.ds-estimate label span{font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-estimate input,.ds-estimate select,.ds-estimate textarea{width:100%;min-height:54px;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:10px;color:#fffef8;background:var(--review-field,#26332f);caret-color:var(--orange,#ff5c35);font:inherit}.ds-estimate textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}.ds-estimate input:focus-visible,.ds-estimate select:focus-visible,.ds-estimate textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff5c35);outline-offset:2px}.ds-full{grid-column:1/-1}.ds-submit{min-height:56px;padding:14px 22px;border:0;border-radius:13px;color:var(--asphalt,#162321);background:var(--orange,#ff5c35);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.ds-submit:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}.ds-submit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff5c35);outline-offset:4px}.ds-note{margin:0;color:#aebbb4;font-size:.9rem}

narrative.overview: J Roofing is presented as a clear roofline evidence board: one strong, visibly disclosed crew concept establishes craft, a compact Google badge supplies verified proof, and direct service and estimate actions carry the visitor forward. Monumental condensed type supplies confidence while customer language—not invented claims—does the persuading. This is a route-specific visual world. It must not inherit another roofing template, its section format, its imagery, or its decorative assets; only shared product facts may cross route boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: One generated crew image anchors the hero, paired with a compact verified Google proof badge.
The hero opens directly on the roof statement; Stockton location proof lives in the factual proof strip rather than a decorative eyebrow.
Asphalt green and mineral paper provide the field; safety orange is the action and proof signal.
Service rows lead directly to a preselected estimate request; the form opens a prefilled SMS to the verified phone.
Generated roofing photography is treated as illustrative concept material, never company project evidence.

rules.name: The Safety Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange signals action, focus, or verified proof; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Material Neutral Rule
rules.body: Green neutrals must read as asphalt, shingle, or metal—not as generic wellness branding.

rules.name: The Stamp-and-Explain Rule
rules.body: Condensed type names the fact; Source Sans explains or substantiates it.

rules.name: The Proof-in-Reach Rule
rules.body: Every major layout state keeps estimate, call, and Google proof paths within immediate reach without inventing a service promise.

rules.name: The Single Visual Anchor Rule
rules.body: Keep the hero to one clearly disclosed image with one compact proof badge; the rest of the route organizes evidence calmly.

dos: Do keep the first viewport to one disclosed crew concept image and one compact Google proof badge.
Do separate verified Google facts and customer quotations from illustrative photography.
Do preserve the 980px and 720px layout changes, reduced-motion behavior, visible focus, and mobile contact bar.
Do keep the hero free of a location eyebrow, retain the one-time roof-settle entrance, and move the concept disclosure to the top-left on mobile.
Do theme the global scrollbar and form caret with the established Asphalt and Safety Orange roles.
Do make every service row link to the estimate form with its service preselected.
Do disclose that estimate submission opens a prefilled SMS to the verified phone and keep the direct-call fallback.
Do source every new visual specifically for this route and label generated imagery as concept material.
donts: Don't reuse a prior website template, imagery set, page format, signature component, or decorative asset.
Don't imply that generated crew, shingle, or gutter images document J Roofing's completed projects.
Don't invent licensing, warranties, financing, certifications, response times, project history, or owner-approved service claims.
Don't reintroduce a layered sample deck, multi-image hero collage, or generic contractor feature-card grid.
Don't imply the estimate form submits to a backend, stores information, or contacts the business automatically.
